$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Settings > Models settings that live in schema rows (cmux-tui/docs/model-connections.md). The Models card draws its connections, order and sign-ins from acpmux (`_acpmux/connections`); its one switch is this row, so the palette, `cmux settings` and MCP reach it. The app mirrors the value into acpmux's routes/bindings.json (`_acpmux/connections/spread.set`, CmuxNextAccounts SettingsModels) at launch, on every change and on every read of the card. gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: models
lists.note: Settings > Models (model connections). The Models card draws the row itself from ModelsState.personal.spread, so it is off the page's schema rows and stays in the palette.

rows.name: spreadUsage
rows.note: acpmux's `spread` (routes/bindings.json): on, a thread may move to another of the person's connections serving the same model when one is out, staying on one while its cache is warm. The app is the writer; acpmux keeps a copy.

help.text: When one subscription runs out, a thread moves to another of your connections that serves the same model.

rows.page_hidden: the Models card draws it beside the connections it spreads over
